subject: NULL-layout fix + 2D slice views; 771 checks
body: Fixed the new NULL-layout read: n2t_pack_layout and n2t_plane_pack now check !l before touching view_format/view_metal; public NULL tests cover n2t_layout_pack_sampled, n2t_texture_pack, n2t_storage_pack, n2t_plane_pack and n2t_layout_subresource. Added explicit support for single-layer 1D/2D/2DMS views with first_layer>0 and a physical array_length; offsets stay view-relative (tested with array_length8/first_layer3). first_layer>0 without array_length refuses; 3D first_layer still refuses. Helper now 771 checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan; n2r suite still PASS both modes. swizzle_valid remains the only struct addition; rebuild consumers. Remaining limitations: no raw struct serialization, bridge transport and normal sampler factory still pending.
